component.name: KnightLoader
component.summary: One download manager for every link

description.p: KnightLoader downloads hoster links, torrents, Usenet files and videos in one queue. Hoster links go through the debrid service you already pay for or straight to the hoster on your own login, torrents to the built-in client, .nzb files to your own Usenet servers, videos to yt-dlp, and whatever is left to a JDownloader that KnightLoader sets up and runs beside itself.

ul.li: Checks every link before it downloads and shows which backend will take it
Sorts links into packages and folders as they arrive, with rules like JDownloader's Packagizer
Takes links from the clipboard, Click'n'Load buttons, the browser extension and the phone app
Unpacks archives, checks checksums and puts files in folders built from templates
Connects to your other KnightLoader instances with twelve words, without a port forward or an account
Takes over your JDownloader accounts, rules, archive passwords and open downloads, with a preview first
Waits in the tray and keeps the machine awake while downloads run

description.p: There is no account, no server of ours in between and no analytics. The Flatpak can reach your home folder and the drives and shares under /media, /run/media and /mnt. A download folder anywhere else needs a filesystem override first.

screenshot.caption: The download list, grouped by package
The overview with the total speed and the latest downloads
The link collector, which checks every link before it downloads

description.p: Many hosters download without JDownloader, the browser extension puts a download button on videos, KnightLoader comes as a Flatpak, and you can put links in a category by hand.

ul.li: Free 1fichier links download on their own, and wait out 1fichier's pause between free files
Rapidgator, Keep2Share, FileBoom, TezFiles, Nitroflare and filer.net download on your premium login
Free Rapidgator, Keep2Share, FileBoom, TezFiles and filer.net links download with their countdown and captcha
ddownload, KatFile, Clicknupload, FileSpace and Uploadrar download free or on your login
Pixeldrain, Gofile and Mediafire links and folders download one row per file
Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SharePoint, WeTransfer and SwissTransfer shares download one row per file
Krakenfiles, Workupload and Send.now links download for free
KnightLoader comes as a Flatpak, and the Apps page offers it for x64 and ARM
The browser extension puts a download button on videos, with every quality and format the video offers
Right-click links to put them in a category, or pick one when adding them
Each category can unpack into its own folder
Ten well-known Usenet providers fill in their server and port when you pick one
A Deepbrid premium account fetches torrents and .nzb files
The Backend column shows the service or client that handles each download
The speed column shows how fast a debrid service fetches a torrent
Removing a download with its files also deletes what unpacking wrote
A login KnightLoader cannot use goes back to JDownloader
Captchas always show, and Stop works while downloads run
Rules can be edited and removed in the Graphic view
A redrawn logo, and KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.3.1
